summary: The bomb, the depth charge, the rocket and the torpedo run one tick, 006E1300, and differ only in two entity vtable slots: +19Ch for air and +1A0h for water. The shared air flight 006E1510 is gravity 9.81 gated on the class NoGravity flag plus a fixed 0.9/0.1 blend of the forward row toward the velocity; the bomb's and the rocket's water advance 006E27F0 is a single RET. The depth charge dives with linear drag on all three axes and gravity still on, scans a 25 m sphere below 5 m of depth and fires the blast site 006FD032 that docs/EXPLOSION_RADIAL_DAMAGE.md already records. The rocket lights after IgnitionDelay and then accelerates along its own world forward axis to VMax. The torpedo levels its nose, damps its velocity with separate axial and lateral coefficients, holds a depth relative to the sampled wave surface and turns toward a commanded heading at HeadingTurn degrees per second; its homing re-scans on an interval for the nearest entity answering vtable[5Ch](8) and turns with two clamped rates. The arming gate record+45Ch is a time, not a distance.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectile_TickAdvance
routines.evidence: Slot +8h of the tick element vtables 00CF93F0 (MBomb), 00CFB9F8 (MDepthCharge), 00D09060 (MRocket) and 00D0C35C (MTorpedo), read from .rdata. Negative launch delay at [this+2Ch] counts up and returns (006E130B, XORPS/COMISS/JBE so the test is strict 0 > value). Active byte [this+74h] at 006E1331. Step rescaled by classDesc[+5Ch] at 006E133B and written back over the argument slot [ESP+20h]. Water query shot->vtable[+2Ch] at 006E1361 picks record->vtable[19Ch] or [1A0h] at 006E138B. Sweep gated on byte record+5Ch (ESI-388h) and on the arming countdown [this+78h] against 00D7A218 = 0.0f. Expiry at 006E1464 compares record+364h against classDesc[+54h]. RET 4 with the float at [ESP+20h] after SUB ESP,0Ch and four pushes.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectile_PlaceStepPose
routines.evidence: Slot +4h of the same four vtables. Same classDesc[+5Ch] rescale at 006E1067 and the same launch-delay gate at 006E1075. Picks record->vtable[194h]/[198h] at 006E10C9, one slot pair below the tick's, matching the bullet's [114h]/[118h] against [11Ch]/[120h] in docs/TICK_ELEMENT_OVERRIDES.md. The air trail at record+338h builds a matrix whose forward row is the step displacement, gated on |d|^2 > 00D7A268 = 1.0e-4f.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectile_CommitStepPose
routines.evidence: Slot +0Ch of 00CF93F0, 00CFB9F8 and 00D09060; MTorpedo replaces it with 00855B00. record+37Ch..384h <- record+370h..378h at 006E1013, then record+370h..378h <- [this+64h..6Ch] at 006E102C, which is the translation row (34h + 30h) of the matrix cached by the previous commit, and only then 004134F0(this+34h, record+0CCh) re-caches. The bullet's 006E7D50 takes current straight from record+FCh, so the bomb family's sweep segment lags one commit.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectile_AdvanceInAir
routines.evidence: Entity vtable slot +19Ch at 00CF95D4 (MBomb), 00CFBC1C (MDepthCharge) and 00D0C584 (MTorpedo). Gravity 00CF9058 = 9.8103800773621 subtracted from record+31Ch only when byte classDesc[+20h] (NoGravity) is clear, together with record+348h..350h times dt inside the same branch. 00419440 on a stack copy of the velocity, reciprocal only for a strictly positive length (006E15CD FCOMI/JBE). Forward row record+94h blended with 00D7A390 = 0.9f and 00D7A3A0 = 0.1f; the +94h and +9Ch stores at 006E160D and 006E1618 write back the values just loaded. 0085DC80(record+74h) rebuilds the basis.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectile_AdvanceInWater
routines.evidence: Entity vtable slot +1A0h for MBomb (00CF95D8) and MRocket (00D09288). One instruction, RET 4: a bomb in the water stops integrating velocity. Read from raw bytes with capstone; Ghidra has no function here.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectile_SweepFlags
routines.evidence: Entity vtable slot +1A4h in all four tables (00CF95DC, 00CFBC24, 00D0928C, 00D0C58C). MOV byte [EAX],1; MOV byte [ECX],1. So the bomb family passes CL = DL = 1, and 006E13D5 forces both to 0 in world mode 2; the bullet instead passes CL = (worldMode != 2), DL = 1 (docs/PROJECTILE_IMPACT.md). Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_BombProjectileShot_IsUnderWater
routines.evidence: Shot interface vtable slot +2Ch at 00CF960C (MBomb), 00CFBA3C (MDepthCharge) and 00D090A4 (MRocket). XOR EAX,EAX; CMP byte [ECX+44h],AL; SETNZ AL. +44h is the underwater flag docs/PROJECTILE_KINDS.md records for 006E6410/006E6450. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_ProjectileShot_AdvanceOwnerGrace
routines.evidence: Called at 006E14F4 with ECX = record+310h. shot[+94h] -= dt; once negative and shot[+C8h] is non-zero it calls BSP_Observer_UnregisterPair and clears shot[+C8h]. shot+C8h is record+3D8h, the owner the sweep passes, so this is the own-fire grace period.

routines.name: BSP_DepthChargeProjectile_AdvanceInWater
routines.coverage: partial: 006FCE8D-006FCF8B read only for its transform calls; after 006FD0AA unread
routines.evidence: Entity vtable slot +1A0h at 00CFBC20. 006FCD28 negates record+468h once and applies it to all three velocity components, keeping gravity 00CF9058 on the vertical, so the terminal sink rate is -9.81/k. Scan gated on worldMode != 2 and record+100h < 00CFBC84 = -5.0f; the per-candidate squared distance is built inline at 006FCE59 and compared with 00CFBC80 = 625.0f, a 25 m radius. Detonation at 006FCFA6 when record+100h < -|record+470h| (AND 7FFFFFFFh).

routines.name: BSP_DepthChargeProjectileShot_EnterWater
routines.evidence: Shot interface vtable slot +28h at 00CFBA38, against 006E6450 in the other three tables. Tests 0042B2F0(shot+8h) > classDesc[+ECh] (MaxWaterHitVel) and shot[+0Ch] < -classDesc[+F0h], the field docs/WEAPON_CLASS_DESCRIPTOR.md calls computed; 00855A90 shows the formula is sqrt(2*MaxFall*9.81). Otherwise calls the base 006E6450 and spawns classDesc[+E8h] WaterSplashEfx. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_RocketProjectile_AdvanceWithIgnition
routines.abi: __thiscall(record, float dt), RET 4, SEH frame at 00C90928
routines.coverage: partial: read to 0080A26A; the trail block from record+47Ch unread
routines.evidence: Entity vtable slot +19Ch at 00D09284, the only kind that replaces the air slot; its water slot is the no-op 006E27F0. record+494h is the ignited flag and record+490h the timer against classDesc[+E0h] IgnitionDelay; the ignition event is shot->vtable[+3Ch] = 00809F20 at 00D090B4, against 006E1CD0 in the other three tables. Thrust at 0080A17C takes the dot of the velocity with the world forward row record+0ECh..0F4h and steps it toward classDesc[+D8h] VMax by classDesc[+DCh] Acceleration times dt. The argument is at [ESP+0ECh] after PUSH -1/PUSH handler/PUSH EAX, SUB ESP,0D4h and two pushes. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoProjectile_CommitStepPose
routines.evidence: Tick element vtable 00D0C35C slot +0Ch, read from .rdata; the base is 006E1010. Calls 006E1010 then, when [this+0BCh] (record+4A0h) is non-null, 004134F0(this+0C0h, [this+0BCh]+74h). 004134F0's destination is ECX, settled by 00857518 where the stack matrix is copied into record+74h.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoClass_FinaliseDerivedFields
routines.evidence: Class descriptor vtable 00CFA56C slot +0Ch, read from .rdata; 00CFA56C+1Ch holds 00856420, the create docs/PROJECTILE_KINDS.md identified, and the table begins right after the MFlakBullet string at 00CFA560. Calls the base 006E9890, writes classDesc+60h = classDesc[+E4h] * classDesc[+54h] * 00CEFF98 (0.6f) and classDesc+0ECh = sqrt(2 * classDesc[+E0h] * 9.81) through the CRT sqrt at 00BF7030, and returns base && classDesc+0ECh > 0. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoProjectileShot_IsUnderWater
routines.evidence: Shot interface vtable 00D0C378 slot +2Ch. Refreshes the pose when record+0C8h is clear, returns 2 when 2 * record+47Ch > record+100h and otherwise record+354h != 0. record+47Ch is [shot+16Ch], the swim depth 008A2710 writes. Both 006E1300 and 006E1060 test with TEST EAX,EAX so 2 and 1 select the same slot. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoProjectile_AdvanceSwim
routines.coverage: partial: 00857480-00857679 complete; the wake tail from 00857679 unread
routines.evidence: Entity vtable 00D0C3E8 slot +1A0h at 00D0C588. record+488h += dt; the heading at record+46Ch is seeded from 00521370 when it equals 00D0C310 = 10000.0f, tested with the UCOMISS/LAHF/TEST AH,44h/JP equality idiom. m.forward.y *= (1 - 00D7A2B0 * dt) with 00D7A2B0 a true double 3.0, then 0085DC80 and 004134F0 back into record+74h. After 00856BB0 the matrix is re-read and the velocity is split with the dot product at 0085753E: v = par*(1 - record+474h*dt) + perp*(1 - record+478h*dt). No thrust term, so classDesc[+E4h] WaterTravelSpeed does not reach the swim. The argument is at [ESP+80h] after FLD [ESP+4], SUB ESP,6Ch and four pushes. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoProjectile_Steer
routines.coverage: partial: complete except the candidate list container 00856C28-00856C63
routines.evidence: Called only from 00857531. Gated on classDesc[+F0h] HomingHorzTurnSpeed > 0 against 00D7A218 = 0.0f. record+518h is the re-scan countdown and record+514h the interval. The scan keeps the smallest 004193E0, which returns a squared length, and binds through 00694A60 into the observer at record+4FCh with the target at record+510h. 00521370 is __fastcall(row, float* pitch, float* yaw) with pitch = asin(clamp(row.y)) in EDX and yaw = atan2 on the stack. Both 00438B10 calls read the same two slots: taking E as ESP at 00856E6C, the first pushes [E+0Ch] and [E+8h] and, because 0085E880 is RET 8, ESP is E-8 at 00856EE8 and the second pushes [E-8+1Ch] = [E+0Ch] and [E-8+10h] = [E+8h]. Those are the two pitch outputs; the yaw outputs at [E+14h] and [E+10h] are not read there. The depth controller at 00856FA9 uses 0078CF20 and clamps record+31Ch to 00CFBC84 = -5.0f and 00CE3850 = +5.0f. The heading controller at 00857061 scales classDesc[+E8h] by 00CE3D28/00CE3D20 = pi/180.

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoProjectileShot_EnterWater
routines.coverage: partial: the two limits and both branches; the effect construction is a contract
routines.evidence: Shot interface vtable 00D0C378 slot +28h, against 006E6450 in the base. Breaks up when the impact speed exceeds classDesc[+DCh] MaxWaterHitVel or shot[+0Ch] < -classDesc[+ECh], the fall speed 00855A90 derives from MaxFall; the same pair as the depth charge's 006FD660 at +ECh/+F0h. In world mode 2 it enters water instead of dying. shot[+44h] is param_1[0x11] and record+0C8h is param_1[-0x92].

routines.name: BSP_TorpedoProjectileShot_GetFlag148
routines.evidence: Shot interface vtable 00D0C378 slot +38h. MOV AL,[ECX+148h]; RET, byte for byte the same as the base 006E2910 at 00CF9618, so the table entry differs but the behaviour does not. Read from raw bytes; no Ghidra function.

no_ghidra_function.evidence: 006EAF20, 006EA550, 006EA520, 00855A90 at +0Ch, 006E97F0, 008566B0 (the reader docs/WEAPON_CLASS_DESCRIPTOR.md names), 006EA530, 00856420 (the create). no_ghidra_function.name: MTorpedo shot interface vtable
no_ghidra_function.evidence: Diffed against MBomb's 00CF95E0, MDepthCharge's 00CFBA10 and MRocket's 00D09078. corrections.what: MTorpedo vtable 00CFA56C overrides one extra slot with 00855A90 (packet brief)
corrections.is: 00CFA56C is the MTorpedo class descriptor vtable, not a tick table, and 00855A90 is its +0Ch finalise hook; the torpedo's tick element table is 00D0C35C and its only tick override is 00855B00 at +0Ch
corrections.evidence: 00CFA56C+1Ch holds 00856420, the create; 00CFA56C begins right after the string MFlakBullet at 00CFA560. 00D0C35C reads 00856240, 006E1060, 006E1300, 00855B00.

corrections.what: the torpedo's model lives at 00855B00 (packet brief)
corrections.is: 00855B00 is the commit slot; the torpedo's motion model is the entity vtable slot +1A0h at 00D0C588, which is 00857480, and its steering is 00856BB0
corrections.evidence: 00855B00 is 34 bytes that call 006E1010 and copy one matrix. 00D0C584 holds 006E1510, 00857480, 006E2800.

corrections.is: the sweep gate record+45Ch is a countdown in seconds decremented by the scaled step at 006E13AF; nothing in the tick measures travelled distance
corrections.evidence: 006E139B compares [this+78h] against 00D7A218, whose four bytes are zero, and the else branch is FSUB of the step.

corrections.what: docs/PROJECTILE_KINDS.md lists 006E1300, 006E1060 and 00855B00 as contract: unread
corrections.is: all three are read here; 006E1300 and 006E1010 are complete, 006E1060 is partial

corrections.what: docs/WEAPON_CLASS_DESCRIPTOR.md records the depth charge's +F0h as computed, not read, without the formula
corrections.is: the formula is sqrt(2 * MaxFall * 9.81), the impact speed of a fall of MaxFall metres, and the torpedo has the same derived field at +ECh
corrections.evidence: 00855AAE-00855AD3 computes it for the torpedo through the CRT sqrt at 00BF7030; 006FD6A6 and 008568E0 both compare the projectile's vertical velocity against its negation.
